errors.text_span: Die y-Achse ist in Millionen Euro angegeben
errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled in Milliarden Euro (billions), not Millionen Euro (millions).
The description does not explicitly state the chart's purpose of illustrating financial flows between 2005 and 2024 in Milliarden Euro.
The description does not mention that the green bars are positioned along the horizontal axis below the zero line, negatively marked.
The description does not mention that the bar values are labeled in Millionen Euro above or below each bar.
The description does not mention that the bars are not sorted in any specific order.
The description does not mention the absence of visual highlighting for any specific bar beyond numerical labels.

The purple line (Zufluss) does not end at 68,045 in 2022; it ends near 20,000 in 2024.
